tagline.en-MY: A fictional modern neighbourhood in the Klang Valley: condos, shoplots, an LRT station and a lake park.
tagline.ms-MY: Kejiranan moden rekaan di Lembah Klang: kondominium, rumah kedai, stesen LRT dan taman tasik.

description.en-MY: Your terrace house in a gated row, with a car porch and a little front gate. Collect rent from the letterbox.
description.ms-MY: Rumah teres anda di deretan berpagar, dengan anjung kereta dan pintu pagar kecil. Kutip sewa dari peti surat.

description.en-MY: A roomy semi-detached home with a side garden, for a growing neighbourhood.
description.ms-MY: Rumah berkembar yang luas dengan taman tepi, untuk kejiranan yang semakin berkembang.

description.en-MY: A slim condo tower with balconies full of plants and a pool deck for residents.
description.ms-MY: Menara kondominium dengan balkoni penuh pokok dan dek kolam renang untuk penghuni.

description.en-MY: Uncle Lim’s kopitiam in a brand-new shoplot row by the LRT, with marble tables on the covered walkway.
description.ms-MY: Kopitiam Pak Cik Lim di deretan rumah kedai baharu berhampiran LRT, dengan meja marmar di kaki lima berbumbung.

perks.ms-MY: Resipi baharu: Set Roti Bakar Kaya

description.en-MY: Mei’s bright dessert café: soft loaves in the morning, mango cake in the afternoon.
description.ms-MY: Kafe pencuci mulut Mei yang ceria: roti lembut waktu pagi, kek mangga waktu petang.

description.en-MY: Raised beds between the condos: orchids, mango trees and vegetables, tended by the whole neighbourhood.
description.ms-MY: Batas tanaman di antara kondominium: orkid, pokok mangga dan sayur-sayuran, dijaga oleh seluruh kejiranan.

description.en-MY: A little glass-fronted florist that turns garden orchids into bouquets and arrangements.
description.ms-MY: Kedai bunga kecil berdinding kaca yang menggubah orkid kebun menjadi jambangan dan gubahan.

description.en-MY: Arjun’s makerspace: he cuts timber, presses bricks and designs furniture — the materials for every upgrade.
description.ms-MY: Ruang kreatif Arjun: dia memotong kayu, membuat bata dan mereka perabot — bahan untuk setiap naik taraf.

description.en-MY: Always open, always bright: grocery boxes, jars of kaya and late-night snacks.
description.ms-MY: Sentiasa buka, sentiasa terang: kotak barang dapur, balang kaya dan snek lewat malam.

description.en-MY: A bright glass showroom for electric cars. Arrange the display; neighbours drop by to look, chat and ask about charging.
description.ms-MY: Bilik pameran kaca yang terang untuk kereta elektrik. Susun pameran; jiran singgah untuk melihat, bersembang dan bertanya tentang pengecasan.

description.en-MY: A friendly tuition centre above the shoplots, with a daily quiz for curious minds.
description.ms-MY: Pusat tuisyen yang mesra di atas rumah kedai, dengan kuiz harian untuk minda yang ingin tahu.

description.en-MY: A leafy park with a jogging track and an exercise station, where neighbours unwind under the rain trees.
description.ms-MY: Taman rimbun dengan trek joging dan stesen senaman, tempat jiran berehat di bawah pokok hujan-hujan.

description.en-MY: The neighbourhood’s community centre, for community dinners, residents’ meetings and rainy-day badminton. Adds an order slot.
description.ms-MY: Pusat komuniti kejiranan, untuk makan malam bersama, mesyuarat penduduk dan badminton hari hujan. Menambah satu slot pesanan.

description.en-MY: Neighbours pin their requests here, right next to the futsal schedule.
description.ms-MY: Jiran menampal permintaan mereka di sini, betul-betul di sebelah jadual futsal.

description.en-MY: Welcome to Bandar Seri Bayu!
description.ms-MY: Selamat datang ke Bandar Seri Bayu!

description.en-MY: A lake park with a timber boardwalk and a little jetty. Good for fishing — catch and release.
description.ms-MY: Taman tasik dengan laluan papan kayu dan jeti kecil. Sesuai untuk memancing — tangkap dan lepas.

description.en-MY: A fountain plaza with shade trees and seating, built together as a community project.
description.ms-MY: Plaza air pancut dengan pokok teduhan dan tempat duduk, dibina bersama sebagai projek komuniti.

description.en-MY: Shah’s 24-hour mamak: roti canai off the griddle, nasi lemak to share and tables out front until late.
description.ms-MY: Restoran mamak 24 jam milik Shah: roti canai panas, nasi lemak untuk dikongsi dan meja di luar sampai lewat malam.

description.en-MY: Bright desks, good kopi and neighbours working on their ideas. Members pay a small desk fee.
description.ms-MY: Meja yang terang, kopi yang sedap dan jiran yang mengusahakan idea mereka. Ahli membayar yuran meja yang kecil.

description.en-MY: A bright lifestyle mall with a food court, a cinema and a rooftop garden.
description.ms-MY: Pusat beli-belah gaya hidup yang terang dengan medan selera, panggung wayang dan taman atas bumbung.

description.en-MY: The neighbourhood school, with a covered drop-off, a green field and a very busy school bus.
description.ms-MY: Sekolah kejiranan, dengan tempat turun murid berbumbung, padang hijau dan bas sekolah yang sangat sibuk.

description.en-MY: A row of shoplots with a family clinic, a pharmacy corner and offices upstairs.
description.ms-MY: Sederet rumah kedai dengan klinik keluarga, sudut farmasi dan pejabat di tingkat atas.

description.en-MY: Fuel pumps, fast EV chargers and a little convenience shop by the main road.
description.ms-MY: Pam minyak, pengecas EV pantas dan kedai serbaneka kecil di tepi jalan besar.

description.en-MY: A weedy corner between the condos. Neighbours want a pocket park with a picnic lawn.
description.ms-MY: Sudut semak di antara kondominium. Jiran-jiran mahu taman poket dengan laman berkelah.

description.en-MY: An empty square by the LRT that could host the neighbourhood’s night market.
description.ms-MY: Dataran kosong berhampiran LRT yang boleh menjadi tapak pasar malam kejiranan.

description.en-MY: A bare lot where the neighbourhood kids dream of swings and a slide.
description.ms-MY: Tanah lapang tempat kanak-kanak kejiranan mengimpikan buaian dan gelongsor.

description.en-MY: A viewing deck with the city skyline glowing on the horizon.
description.ms-MY: Dek tinjau dengan latar bandar raya yang bergemerlapan di kaki langit.

description.en-MY: A wide, shady canopy over the street.
description.ms-MY: Kanopi luas dan redup di tepi jalan.

description.en-MY: Tall, straight and very neat.
description.ms-MY: Tinggi, lurus dan sangat kemas.

description.en-MY: Bursts of pink paper petals all year.
description.ms-MY: Kelopak kertas merah jambu sepanjang tahun.

description.en-MY: Clusters of bright orange-red flowers.
description.ms-MY: Gugusan bunga jingga kemerahan yang terang.

description.en-MY: A patch of orchids and periwinkles.
description.ms-MY: Sepetak orkid dan kemunting cina.

description.en-MY: Neighbours sit and chat here.
description.ms-MY: Jiran duduk dan bersembang di sini.

description.en-MY: Bright, efficient and warm at night.
description.ms-MY: Terang, jimat tenaga dan hangat pada waktu malam.

description.en-MY: A smart, modern railing.
description.ms-MY: Pagar besi yang kemas dan moden.

description.en-MY: Lemongrass, pandan and chilli in a modern pot.
description.ms-MY: Serai, pandan dan cili dalam pasu moden.

description.en-MY: A smooth landscaping stone.
description.ms-MY: Batu landskap yang licin.

description.en-MY: A fan of big leaves. Very photogenic.
description.ms-MY: Daun besar berbentuk kipas. Sangat fotogenik.

description.en-MY: Paper, plastic and cans — all sorted.
description.ms-MY: Kertas, plastik dan tin — semuanya diasingkan.

description.en-MY: Deliveries wait here until you get home.
description.ms-MY: Bungkusan menunggu di sini sehingga anda pulang.

description.en-MY: The postman stops here.
description.ms-MY: Posmen singgah di sini.

description.en-MY: Uncle Lim’s thank-you gift.
description.ms-MY: Hadiah terima kasih Pak Cik Lim.

description.en-MY: Mak Cik Zainab’s keepsake: the sunbirds love it.
description.ms-MY: Kenangan Mak Cik Zainab: burung kelicap sangat suka.

description.en-MY: Mei’s dessert-sale cart.
description.ms-MY: Troli jualan pencuci mulut Mei.

description.en-MY: Orchid Festival reward.
description.ms-MY: Ganjaran Pesta Orkid.

description.en-MY: A post hung with warm garden lanterns.
description.ms-MY: Tiang dengan lampu taman yang hangat.

description.en-MY: Marks the year the Fountain Plaza was built together.
description.ms-MY: Menandakan tahun Plaza Air Pancut dibina bersama.

description.en-MY: From the pocket park’s opening picnic.
description.ms-MY: Dari kelah pembukaan taman poket.

description.en-MY: A little stall like the ones at the Bayu Plaza night market.
description.ms-MY: Gerai kecil seperti di pasar malam Dataran Bayu.

description.en-MY: A wau kite from the playground’s opening day.
description.ms-MY: Wau dari hari pembukaan taman permainan.

description.en-MY: For stargazing, like up on the Skyline Deck.
description.ms-MY: Untuk melihat bintang, seperti di Dek Langit.

description.en-MY: Strong, sweet and brewed through a cloth sock, old-town style.
description.ms-MY: Pekat, manis dan dibancuh melalui kain saring, cara pekan lama.

description.en-MY: A soft white loaf, still warm.
description.ms-MY: Sebuku roti putih yang lembut, masih panas.

description.en-MY: Purple and white orchids from the community garden.
description.ms-MY: Orkid ungu dan putih dari kebun komuniti.

description.en-MY: A ripe, golden mango from the garden tree.
description.ms-MY: Sebiji mangga masak keemasan dari pokok di kebun.

description.en-MY: Kangkung, long beans and chillies.
description.ms-MY: Kangkung, kacang panjang dan cili.

description.en-MY: Kopi, kaya toast and soft-boiled eggs — the perfect start.
description.ms-MY: Kopi, roti bakar kaya dan telur separuh masak — permulaan yang sempurna.

description.en-MY: Mei’s mango cake, light as a cloud.
description.ms-MY: Kek mangga Mei, ringan seperti awan.

description.en-MY: A hand-tied bouquet wrapped in kraft paper.
description.ms-MY: Jambangan bunga yang diikat tangan dan dibalut kertas kraf.

description.en-MY: Orchids arranged in a ceramic pot, for a special table.
description.ms-MY: Orkid digubah dalam pasu seramik, untuk meja yang istimewa.

description.en-MY: Sustainably sourced timber for upgrades.
description.ms-MY: Kayu daripada sumber lestari untuk naik taraf.

description.en-MY: Sturdy bricks pressed at the makerspace.
description.ms-MY: Bata kukuh yang dibuat di ruang kreatif.

description.en-MY: A curvy timber chair designed by Arjun.
description.ms-MY: Kerusi kayu melengkung rekaan Arjun.

description.en-MY: A generous box of fresh groceries.
description.ms-MY: Kotak barang dapur segar yang penuh.

description.en-MY: Coconut jam, slow-stirred for hours.
description.ms-MY: Seri kaya, dikacau perlahan berjam-jam.

description.en-MY: Flaky, buttery and flipped to order.
description.ms-MY: Rangup, lembut dan ditebar ikut pesanan.

description.en-MY: Fragrant coconut rice with sambal, egg and peanuts.
description.ms-MY: Nasi santan yang wangi dengan sambal, telur dan kacang.

bio.en-MY: His late father ran an old-town kopitiam for forty years. Now Uncle Lim has reopened it in a brand-new shoplot by the LRT — same recipes, same marble tables, new air-conditioning.
bio.ms-MY: Ayahnya dahulu mengusahakan kopitiam di pekan lama selama empat puluh tahun. Kini Pak Cik Lim membukanya semula di rumah kedai baharu berhampiran LRT — resipi sama, meja marmar sama, penghawa dingin baharu.

text.en-MY: Ah, you’re here! Come, sit — the kettle is always on.
text.ms-MY: Ha, sampai pun! Mari duduk — cerek sentiasa panas.

text.en-MY: Morning! The first train just passed. That means the first kopi is ready.
text.ms-MY: Selamat pagi! Tren pertama baru lalu. Maksudnya kopi pertama dah siap.

text.en-MY: Evening already? The shutters are half down, but for you, still open.
text.ms-MY: Dah petang? Pintu besi separuh tutup, tapi untuk awak, masih buka.

text.en-MY: Can’t sleep either? Shah’s mamak is still busy. I’m soaking tomorrow’s coffee beans.
text.ms-MY: Tak boleh tidur juga? Mamak Shah masih sibuk. Saya sedang rendam biji kopi untuk esok.

text.en-MY: A good kopi is like a good neighbour — strong, warm and always there in the morning.
text.ms-MY: Kopi yang baik macam jiran yang baik — pekat, hangat dan sentiasa ada waktu pagi.

text.en-MY: My father roasted his beans with a little butter and sugar. New shop, same way.
text.ms-MY: Ayah saya goreng biji kopi dengan sedikit mentega dan gula. Kedai baharu, cara yang sama.

text.en-MY: The office crowd from the LRT orders “kopi ais, less sweet, takeaway”. My smile still comes free.
text.ms-MY: Orang pejabat dari LRT pesan “kopi ais, kurang manis, bungkus”. Senyuman saya tetap percuma.

text.en-MY: Shah opens his mamak when I close. Between the two of us, this corner never sleeps.
text.ms-MY: Shah buka mamak bila saya tutup. Antara kami berdua, simpang ini tak pernah tidur.

text.en-MY: Mei says I should add a matcha menu. Maybe. Don’t tell her I said maybe.
text.ms-MY: Mei kata saya patut tambah menu matcha. Mungkin. Jangan beritahu dia saya kata mungkin.

text.en-MY: I thought a new shoplot would feel strange. You and the neighbours made it feel like Father’s old shop.
text.ms-MY: Saya ingat rumah kedai baharu akan terasa asing. Awak dan jiran-jiran buat ia terasa macam kedai lama ayah.

text.en-MY: Every time I pull the shutters up, I remember the day you helped me reopen.
text.ms-MY: Setiap kali saya angkat pintu besi, saya ingat hari awak bantu saya buka semula kedai.

text.en-MY: The marble tables on the walkway — people stay for a second cup now, even the office crowd.
text.ms-MY: Meja marmar di kaki lima — orang duduk lama untuk cawan kedua sekarang, orang pejabat pun sama.

text.en-MY: The Fountain Plaza — my afternoon kopi tastes better with that splashing sound.
text.ms-MY: Plaza Air Pancut — kopi petang saya lebih sedap dengan bunyi air itu.

text.en-MY: A night market by the LRT! Father would have opened a stall there.
text.ms-MY: Pasar malam tepi LRT! Kalau ayah masih ada, mesti dia buka gerai di situ.

love.en-MY: Wah, my favourite! You remember better than my regulars.
love.ms-MY: Wah, kegemaran saya! Awak lebih ingat daripada pelanggan tetap saya.

like.en-MY: So thoughtful. Come, your next kopi is on me.
like.ms-MY: Baiknya awak. Mari, kopi seterusnya saya belanja.

neutral.en-MY: Thank you, ah! I’ll find a good use for it.
neutral.ms-MY: Terima kasih! Saya akan guna dengan baik.

bio.en-MY: Trained in a big hotel pastry kitchen in the city, then opened her own dessert café so she could see people’s faces at the first bite. Experiments with pandan, gula melaka and mango.
bio.ms-MY: Pernah bekerja di dapur pastri hotel besar di bandar, kemudian membuka kafe pencuci mulut sendiri supaya dapat melihat wajah orang pada suapan pertama. Suka mencuba pandan, gula melaka dan mangga.

text.en-MY: Hi! Mind the tray — it’s still hot.
text.ms-MY: Hai! Hati-hati dulang tu — masih panas.

text.en-MY: Morning! The first loaves just came out, and the queue has already started.
text.ms-MY: Selamat pagi! Roti pertama baru keluar, dan barisan dah pun bermula.

text.en-MY: Evening! Only a few slices of mango cake left — I saved you one.
text.ms-MY: Selamat petang! Kek mangga tinggal beberapa potong — saya simpan satu untuk awak.

text.en-MY: Shh, Biscuit is asleep under the counter. I’m proofing dough for tomorrow.
text.ms-MY: Shh, Biskut tidur bawah kaunter. Saya sedang naikkan doh untuk esok.

text.en-MY: Bread is patient. You can’t rush it, only love it.
text.ms-MY: Roti perlukan sabar. Tak boleh gopoh, cuma sayang.

text.en-MY: Uncle Lim pretends he doesn’t like my kaya. He’s had three slices today.
text.ms-MY: Pak Cik Lim buat-buat tak suka kaya saya. Dah tiga keping hari ini.

text.en-MY: I’m working on a mango cake that doesn’t sink in the middle. Version eleven.
text.ms-MY: Saya sedang cuba kek mangga yang tak mendap di tengah. Versi kesebelas.

text.en-MY: Biscuit knows the sound of the cake tin opening. She can hear it from the condo.
text.ms-MY: Biskut dah kenal bunyi tin kek dibuka. Dia boleh dengar dari kondo.

text.en-MY: Baking for neighbours feels different from a hotel. Here, I see you smile.
text.ms-MY: Membakar untuk jiran rasa lain daripada di hotel. Di sini, saya nampak awak senyum.

text.en-MY: The day the café opened, I baked until midnight out of pure happiness.
text.ms-MY: Hari kafe dibuka, saya bakar sampai tengah malam sebab terlalu gembira.

text.en-MY: Remember the dessert sale? Sold out before the LRT crowd even arrived!
text.ms-MY: Ingat jualan pencuci mulut itu? Habis sebelum orang dari LRT pun sampai!

text.en-MY: Uncle Lim still keeps his birthday card on the counter. He says it’s “for decoration”.
text.ms-MY: Pak Cik Lim masih letak kad hari jadinya di kaunter. Katanya “untuk hiasan”.

love.en-MY: Oh! This is exactly what I needed for a new recipe!
love.ms-MY: Oh! Ini betul-betul yang saya perlukan untuk resipi baharu!

like.en-MY: Lovely, thank you! Biscuit approves too.
like.ms-MY: Cantiknya, terima kasih! Biskut pun setuju.

neutral.en-MY: Thanks! I’ll put it to good use.

bio.en-MY: Taught primary science for thirty-four years. When she retired, she turned the empty lot between the condos into a community garden. Now she knows every plant, bird and neighbour by name.
bio.ms-MY: Mengajar Sains sekolah rendah selama tiga puluh empat tahun. Selepas bersara, dia menjadikan tanah kosong di antara kondominium sebuah kebun komuniti. Kini dia kenal setiap pokok, burung dan jiran.

text.en-MY: Ah, come in! Look at the orchids today.
text.ms-MY: Ha, masuklah! Tengok orkid hari ini.

text.en-MY: Good morning. The dew is still on the leaves — best time to water.
text.ms-MY: Selamat pagi. Embun masih di daun — masa terbaik untuk menyiram.

text.en-MY: The sun is going down behind the condos. Listen — the birds are saying goodnight.
text.ms-MY: Matahari terbenam di sebalik kondominium. Dengar — burung sedang ucap selamat malam.

text.en-MY: A garden teaches patience better than any classroom.
text.ms-MY: Kebun mengajar sabar lebih baik daripada mana-mana bilik darjah.

text.en-MY: Lemongrass by the gate, pandan by the drain. My mother’s rule, even in the city.
text.ms-MY: Serai di tepi pagar, pandan di tepi longkang. Petua emak saya, di bandar pun sama.

text.en-MY: The condo children help me plant every Saturday. They ask a hundred questions. I answer every one.
text.ms-MY: Budak-budak kondo tolong saya menanam setiap Sabtu. Mereka tanya seratus soalan. Saya jawab semuanya.

text.en-MY: We compost the coffee grounds from Uncle Lim’s shop. The mango tree has never been happier.
text.ms-MY: Kami jadikan ampas kopi dari kedai Pak Cik Lim sebagai kompos. Pokok mangga tak pernah segembira ini.

text.en-MY: You have good hands for growing things. I can tell.
text.ms-MY: Tangan awak sejuk, sesuai untuk bercucuk tanam. Saya boleh nampak.

text.en-MY: The first sprout in our community garden — I still have the photo.
text.ms-MY: Tunas pertama di kebun komuniti kita — gambarnya masih saya simpan.

text.en-MY: Our Fountain Plaza — built by everyone. The sunbirds come to drink there now.
text.ms-MY: Plaza Air Pancut kita — dibina bersama. Burung kelicap datang minum di situ sekarang.

text.en-MY: The pocket park was a weedy corner once. Now the children have a lawn.
text.ms-MY: Taman poket itu dulu sudut semak. Sekarang budak-budak ada padang rumput.

text.en-MY: Every time I see Biscuit near the condo garden, I hide the roti.
text.ms-MY: Setiap kali nampak Biskut dekat taman kondo, saya sorokkan roti.

love.en-MY: Wah, cantiknya! You know me so well.
love.ms-MY: Wah, cantiknya! Awak memang kenal saya.

like.en-MY: Thank you, dear. It will brighten my kitchen.
like.ms-MY: Terima kasih, nak. Dapur saya pun jadi ceria.

neutral.en-MY: How kind of you, thank you.

bio.en-MY: Designs furniture at the makerspace, from curvy timber chairs to bricks for the next upgrade. Coaches the neighbourhood kids’ futsal on Saturdays and is very loud about it.
bio.ms-MY: Mereka perabot di ruang kreatif, daripada kerusi kayu melengkung hingga bata untuk naik taraf seterusnya. Melatih futsal budak-budak kejiranan setiap Sabtu dan sangat bersemangat tentangnya.

text.en-MY: Yo! Careful, sawdust everywhere.
text.ms-MY: Hai! Hati-hati, habuk kayu di mana-mana.

text.en-MY: Morning! Machines on, music on, kopi on.
text.ms-MY: Pagi! Mesin hidup, muzik hidup, kopi pun ada.

text.en-MY: Evening! Futsal at eight — you’re on my team.
text.ms-MY: Petang! Futsal pukul lapan — awak masuk pasukan saya.

text.en-MY: Measure twice, cut once. Same with friendships, actually.
text.ms-MY: Ukur dua kali, potong sekali. Persahabatan pun sama, sebenarnya.

text.en-MY: The futsal kids want a proper bench for the sidelines. I’m on it.
text.ms-MY: Budak-budak futsal nak bangku yang betul di tepi gelanggang. Saya sedang buat.

text.en-MY: A good chair is like a good friend: it always has your back.
text.ms-MY: Kerusi yang baik macam kawan yang baik: sentiasa menyokong awak.

text.en-MY: After futsal we all end up at Shah’s. Win or lose, the roti canai tastes just as good.
text.ms-MY: Lepas futsal, kami semua ke kedai Shah. Menang atau kalah, roti canai tetap sedap.

text.en-MY: This makerspace is the best thing that happened to me. Thank you, really.
text.ms-MY: Ruang kreatif ini perkara terbaik yang pernah berlaku pada saya. Terima kasih, betul.

text.en-MY: Forty-seven slide tests. I counted. The kids counted louder.
text.ms-MY: Empat puluh tujuh kali uji gelongsor. Saya kira. Budak-budak kira lebih kuat.

bio.en-MY: Runs the tuition centre above the shoplots with endless patience and a cupboard full of puzzle books. Believes every question is a good one, even “Cikgu, can we go home now?”
bio.ms-MY: Mengendalikan pusat tuisyen di atas rumah kedai dengan penuh sabar dan almari penuh buku teka-teki. Percaya setiap soalan ialah soalan yang baik, walaupun “Cikgu, boleh balik sekarang?”

text.en-MY: Hello! Ready for today’s question?
text.ms-MY: Hai! Sedia untuk soalan hari ini?

text.en-MY: Good morning! Fresh minds learn fastest.
text.ms-MY: Selamat pagi! Minda yang segar cepat belajar.

text.en-MY: Evening! The after-school crowd just left. My whiteboard needs a holiday.
text.ms-MY: Petang! Budak-budak lepas sekolah baru balik. Papan putih saya perlukan cuti.

text.en-MY: Getting an answer wrong is just learning in progress.
text.ms-MY: Tersalah jawab cuma tanda sedang belajar.

text.en-MY: I keep a jar of jasmine on my desk. It keeps the room calm, even in exam week.
text.ms-MY: Saya simpan sebalang melur di atas meja. Bilik terasa tenang, walaupun minggu peperiksaan.

text.en-MY: Mak Cik Zainab taught me science when I was nine. Now we swap books at the community garden.
text.ms-MY: Mak Cik Zainab ajar saya Sains masa saya sembilan tahun. Sekarang kami bertukar buku di kebun komuniti.

text.en-MY: Parents ask me the secret to good results. Sleep, breakfast and curiosity. Mostly breakfast.
text.ms-MY: Ibu bapa tanya rahsia keputusan cemerlang. Tidur, sarapan dan rasa ingin tahu. Terutamanya sarapan.

text.en-MY: Our tuition centre — every chair filled after school. Because of you.
text.ms-MY: Pusat tuisyen kita — setiap kerusi penuh selepas sekolah. Kerana awak.

text.en-MY: You were my very first student here. I still keep your quiz sheet.
text.ms-MY: Awak murid pertama saya di sini. Kertas kuiz awak masih saya simpan.

love.en-MY: For me? How lovely — thank you!

neutral.en-MY: Thank you! Gold star for you.
neutral.ms-MY: Terima kasih! Bintang emas untuk awak.

bio.en-MY: The residents’ association volunteer with a clipboard for every occasion and a group chat for every street. Organises the gotong-royong, the night market and the futsal schedule.
bio.ms-MY: Sukarelawan persatuan penduduk yang ada papan klip untuk setiap majlis dan kumpulan sembang untuk setiap jalan. Menggerakkan gotong-royong, pasar malam dan jadual futsal.

text.en-MY: There you are! I have ideas. Many ideas.
text.ms-MY: Ha, jumpa pun! Saya ada idea. Banyak idea.

text.en-MY: Morning! I’ve already jogged two laps and sent four reminders.
text.ms-MY: Pagi! Saya dah joging dua pusingan dan hantar empat peringatan.

text.en-MY: Evening! Perfect weather for a gathering.
text.ms-MY: Petang! Cuaca sesuai untuk berkumpul.

text.en-MY: Gotong-royong works because nobody is too important to sweep.
text.ms-MY: Gotong-royong berjaya sebab tiada siapa terlalu penting untuk menyapu.

text.en-MY: Next on my list: lights along the lake boardwalk.
text.ms-MY: Seterusnya dalam senarai saya: lampu di sepanjang laluan papan tasik.

text.en-MY: The residents’ group chat has 312 members and about 4,000 sticker replies. I read every one.
text.ms-MY: Kumpulan sembang penduduk ada 312 ahli dan kira-kira 4,000 balasan pelekat. Saya baca semuanya.

text.en-MY: You never say no when the neighbourhood needs help. People notice.
text.ms-MY: Awak tak pernah menolak bila kejiranan perlukan bantuan. Orang perasan.

text.en-MY: The park opening — the whole neighbourhood came, even the early-morning joggers!
text.ms-MY: Perasmian taman — satu kejiranan datang, pelari pagi pun ada!

text.en-MY: The pocket park picnic went exactly to plan. Okay, ninety percent. Okay, it was perfect.
text.ms-MY: Kelah di taman poket ikut rancangan sepenuhnya. Okey, sembilan puluh peratus. Okey, memang sempurna.

text.en-MY: Our night market at Bayu Plaza — I drew the stall map myself.
text.ms-MY: Pasar malam kita di Dataran Bayu — saya lukis peta gerai sendiri.

love.en-MY: Oh, I love this! Perfect for the next event!
love.ms-MY: Oh, saya suka! Sesuai untuk acara seterusnya!

like.en-MY: Thank you so much! Adding you to my thank-you list.
like.ms-MY: Terima kasih banyak! Saya masukkan awak dalam senarai terima kasih.

neutral.en-MY: Thanks! I’ll find a use for it.

bio.en-MY: Runs the EV showroom and explains charging so patiently that even Uncle Lim now says “kilowatt” with confidence. Honest to a fault, and a little too excited about regenerative braking.
bio.ms-MY: Mengurus bilik pameran EV dan menerangkan cara mengecas dengan begitu sabar sehingga Pak Cik Lim pun kini sebut “kilowatt” dengan yakin. Jujur orangnya, dan agak terlalu teruja tentang brek regeneratif.

text.en-MY: Hey! Come see how the light hits the paint today.
text.ms-MY: Hai! Mari tengok cahaya pada cat kereta hari ini.

text.en-MY: Morning! Chargers checked, cars polished, kopi in hand.
text.ms-MY: Pagi! Pengecas dah diperiksa, kereta dah digilap, kopi di tangan.

text.en-MY: Evening! Quiet hour — best time to ask me anything about charging.
text.ms-MY: Petang! Waktu tenang — masa terbaik untuk tanya apa-apa tentang pengecasan.

text.en-MY: A good showroom is about the story, not the shine.
text.ms-MY: Bilik pameran yang baik tentang ceritanya, bukan kilatnya.

text.en-MY: Try arranging the cars by colour. It feels like a garden.
text.ms-MY: Cuba susun kereta ikut warna. Rasa macam taman.

text.en-MY: Charging is like topping up your phone. Plug in, have a kopi, done.
text.ms-MY: Mengecas macam cas telefon. Pasang, minum kopi, siap.

text.en-MY: I like that people here just come to look and chat. No pressure.
text.ms-MY: Saya suka orang di sini datang tengok dan bersembang sahaja. Tiada tekanan.

text.en-MY: The showroom’s first morning — I polished every car twice.
text.ms-MY: Pagi pertama bilik pameran — saya gilap setiap kereta dua kali.

text.en-MY: People still stop to smile at the colour display. Best idea we ever had.
text.ms-MY: Orang masih berhenti tersenyum melihat susunan warna itu. Idea terbaik kita.

love.en-MY: Seriously? This is great, thank you!

like.en-MY: Thanks — my happiness battery is at 100%.
like.ms-MY: Terima kasih — bateri gembira saya penuh 100%.

bio.en-MY: Grew up in Sabah with Mount Kinabalu outside her window; now it’s the city skyline from her condo balcony. Photographs sunsets, shopfronts and the people who make a place feel like home.
bio.ms-MY: Membesar di Sabah dengan Gunung Kinabalu di luar tingkap; kini latar bandar raya dari balkoni kondonya. Merakam matahari terbenam, deretan kedai dan orang yang menjadikan sesuatu tempat terasa seperti rumah.

text.en-MY: Hold still — the light is perfect! …Okay, hi!
text.ms-MY: Jangan bergerak — cahayanya sempurna! …Okey, hai!

text.en-MY: Morning! Golden hour on the lake. I’ve been up since six.
text.ms-MY: Pagi! Cahaya keemasan di tasik. Saya dah bangun sejak pukul enam.

text.en-MY: The skyline is glowing tonight. Want to see the photos?
text.ms-MY: Latar bandar bersinar malam ini. Nak tengok gambar-gambarnya?

text.en-MY: Try photo mode on the lake boardwalk at sunset. Trust me.
text.ms-MY: Cuba mod foto di laluan papan tasik waktu senja. Percayalah.

text.en-MY: Seri Bayu has real character. After the rain, the shoplots glow.
text.ms-MY: Seri Bayu ada jiwa. Selepas hujan, deretan kedai bersinar.

text.en-MY: Back home in Sabah we wave at everyone. I’m bringing that here, one neighbour at a time.
text.ms-MY: Di kampung saya di Sabah, kami melambai kepada semua orang. Saya bawa tabiat itu ke sini, seorang jiran demi seorang.

text.en-MY: My condo has the best window light I’ve ever had.
text.ms-MY: Kondo saya ada cahaya tingkap paling cantik pernah saya dapat.

text.en-MY: Aisyah added me to three group chats on my first day. I’ve photographed everyone in them.
text.ms-MY: Aisyah masukkan saya dalam tiga kumpulan sembang pada hari pertama. Saya dah ambil gambar semua ahlinya.

text.en-MY: The Skyline Deck at night… I could stay up there until the last train.
text.ms-MY: Dek Langit pada waktu malam… Saya boleh duduk di situ sampai tren terakhir.

love.en-MY: I need a photo of this first!
love.ms-MY: Saya nak ambil gambar ini dulu!

like.en-MY: Lovely — this is going on my balcony!

bio.en-MY: Runs the 24-hour mamak on the corner, where everyone ends up after futsal. Can flip a roti canai, take six orders and remember your usual, all at the same time.
bio.ms-MY: Mengusahakan restoran mamak 24 jam di simpang, tempat semua orang singgah selepas futsal. Boleh tebar roti canai, ambil enam pesanan dan ingat pesanan biasa awak, semuanya serentak.

text.en-MY: Eh, boss! The usual? Sit, sit.
text.ms-MY: Eh, bos! Macam biasa? Duduk, duduk.

text.en-MY: Morning! First batch of roti canai, still crispy.
text.ms-MY: Pagi! Roti canai yang pertama, masih rangup.

text.en-MY: Evening! The futsal team booked the long table again.
text.ms-MY: Petang! Pasukan futsal dah tempah meja panjang lagi.

text.en-MY: Midnight? Perfect time for teh tarik and a chat. We never close.
text.ms-MY: Tengah malam? Masa sesuai untuk teh tarik dan bersembang. Kami tak pernah tutup.

text.en-MY: A mamak is a living room with better food. Everyone’s welcome.
text.ms-MY: Mamak ni macam ruang tamu, cuma makanannya lebih sedap. Semua orang dialu-alukan.

text.en-MY: Uncle Lim closes, I open. We wave across the shoplots like a relay race.
text.ms-MY: Pak Cik Lim tutup, saya buka. Kami melambai merentasi deretan kedai macam lari berganti-ganti.

text.en-MY: Arjun says his team lost because of the referee. Every week. Same referee: his own nephew.
text.ms-MY: Arjun kata pasukannya kalah sebab pengadil. Setiap minggu. Pengadil yang sama: anak saudaranya sendiri.

text.en-MY: The secret to good roti canai? Patience, a hot griddle and a little showing off.
text.ms-MY: Rahsia roti canai yang sedap? Sabar, kuali leper yang panas dan sedikit gaya.

text.en-MY: You’re a regular now. Here, regulars get their name called out the moment they walk in.
text.ms-MY: Awak dah jadi pelanggan tetap. Di sini, nama pelanggan tetap dipanggil sebaik sahaja mereka masuk.

text.en-MY: Opening night, the whole street came. We ran out of chairs by ten.
text.ms-MY: Malam pembukaan, satu jalan datang. Kerusi habis sebelum pukul sepuluh.

text.en-MY: The new canopy tables — now the after-futsal crowd stays till midnight.
text.ms-MY: Meja bawah kanopi yang baharu — sekarang geng lepas futsal duduk sampai tengah malam.

text.en-MY: Night market at Bayu Plaza! I brought the griddle. People queued for an hour.
text.ms-MY: Pasar malam di Dataran Bayu! Saya bawa kuali leper. Orang beratur sejam.

love.en-MY: Wah, boss! This one I’ll remember forever.
love.ms-MY: Wah, bos! Yang ini saya ingat sampai bila-bila.

like.en-MY: Thank you! Your next teh tarik is on the house.
like.ms-MY: Terima kasih! Teh tarik seterusnya saya belanja.

intro.en-MY: Welcome to Seri Bayu! I’m Uncle Lim, from the new shoplots by the LRT. Your terrace house has been collecting rent while you unpacked — tap the coins above it!
intro.ms-MY: Selamat datang ke Seri Bayu! Saya Pak Cik Lim, dari rumah kedai baharu berhampiran LRT. Rumah teres awak dah kumpul sewa semasa awak berkemas — ketik syiling di atasnya!

outro.en-MY: See? This neighbourhood already looks after you.
outro.ms-MY: Nampak? Kejiranan ini dah jaga awak.

why.en-MY: Houses earn coins over time — even while you’re away.
why.ms-MY: Rumah menjana syiling dari masa ke masa — walaupun anda tiada.

intro.en-MY: My late father ran a kopitiam in the old town for forty years. I’ve rented a brand-new shoplot by the LRT to bring it back… Will you help me open it?
intro.ms-MY: Ayah saya dahulu mengusahakan kopitiam di pekan lama selama empat puluh tahun. Saya dah sewa rumah kedai baharu berhampiran LRT untuk menghidupkannya semula… Sudikah awak bantu saya membukanya?

outro.en-MY: The shutters are up! I can already hear the cups clinking.
outro.ms-MY: Pintu besi dah naik! Saya dah boleh dengar bunyi cawan berlaga.

why.en-MY: Uncle Lim has dreamed of reopening his father’s kopitiam for years.
why.ms-MY: Pak Cik Lim sudah lama bermimpi untuk membuka semula kopitiam ayahnya.

intro.en-MY: Let’s brew! Tap the kopitiam and make some kopi.
intro.ms-MY: Jom bancuh! Ketik kopitiam dan buat kopi.

outro.en-MY: Smell that? That’s Seri Bayu waking up.
outro.ms-MY: Bau tu? Itulah bau Seri Bayu yang baru bangun.

why.en-MY: Shops turn time into goods your neighbours want.
why.ms-MY: Kedai menukar masa menjadi barangan yang jiran mahukan.

intro.en-MY: Someone pinned a note on the Community Board! Open Orders and deliver it.
intro.ms-MY: Ada nota di Papan Komuniti! Buka Pesanan dan hantarkannya.

outro.en-MY: Our first happy customer. You’re a natural!
outro.ms-MY: Pelanggan pertama yang gembira. Awak memang berbakat!

intro.en-MY: The office crowd from the LRT wants to sit outside on the covered walkway… What if we upgraded the kopitiam with more tables?
intro.ms-MY: Orang pejabat dari LRT mahu duduk di luar, di kaki lima berbumbung… Apa kata kita naik taraf kopitiam dengan lebih banyak meja?

outro.en-MY: Marble tables and round stools — just like my father had!
outro.ms-MY: Meja marmar dan bangku bulat — sama macam zaman ayah saya!

why.en-MY: Upgrades add recipes and slots — and you’ll see the shop change.
why.ms-MY: Naik taraf menambah resipi dan slot — dan anda akan nampak kedai berubah.

intro.en-MY: Mak Cik Zainab, a retired science teacher from the condo, wants to turn the empty lot between the towers into a garden. A Community Garden would bring her right here!
intro.ms-MY: Mak Cik Zainab, guru Sains bersara dari kondominium, mahu jadikan tanah kosong di antara menara itu sebuah kebun. Kebun Komuniti pasti bawa dia ke sini!

outro.en-MY: Zainab is here — Seri Bayu is growing greener!
outro.ms-MY: Zainab dah sampai — Seri Bayu semakin hijau!

why.en-MY: Mak Cik Zainab will join the neighbourhood once there’s a garden.
why.ms-MY: Mak Cik Zainab akan menyertai kejiranan bila ada kebun.

intro.en-MY: Kaya toast needs good bread. A pastry chef called Mei is looking for a shoplot for her dessert café.
intro.ms-MY: Roti bakar kaya perlukan roti yang sedap. Seorang cef pastri bernama Mei sedang mencari rumah kedai untuk kafe pencuci mulutnya.

outro.en-MY: Mei is already kneading. What a smell!
outro.ms-MY: Mei dah mula menguli. Wanginya!

intro.en-MY: A neighbourhood should look like the people who live in it. Plant some trees, flowers or paths!
intro.ms-MY: Kejiranan patut mencerminkan penduduknya. Tanamlah pokok, bunga atau buat laluan!

outro.en-MY: Now it feels like home, not just an address.
outro.ms-MY: Sekarang terasa seperti rumah, bukan sekadar alamat.

intro.en-MY: See that weedy corner between the condos? The whole neighbourhood wants to turn it into a little park — gotong-royong style. Shall we help clear it?
intro.ms-MY: Nampak sudut semak di antara kondominium itu? Seluruh kejiranan mahu jadikannya taman kecil — cara gotong-royong. Jom kita bantu bersihkan?

outro.en-MY: Look at it already! Everyone noticed — that’s what neighbours do.
outro.ms-MY: Tengoklah! Semua orang perasan — itulah gunanya jiran.

intro.en-MY: Flowers, benches, and then a picnic to open it. One step at a time — give whenever you have something spare.
intro.ms-MY: Bunga, bangku, kemudian kelah untuk membukanya. Selangkah demi selangkah — beri bila ada lebihan.

outro.en-MY: A picnic in our own pocket park! Thank you for making this happen together.
outro.ms-MY: Berkelah di taman poket kita sendiri! Terima kasih kerana menjayakannya bersama.

intro.en-MY: The Community Board is full of notes! Let’s help everyone out.
intro.ms-MY: Papan Komuniti penuh dengan nota! Jom bantu semua orang.

outro.en-MY: Word is spreading — even the residents’ group chat is talking about us.
outro.ms-MY: Berita tersebar — kumpulan sembang penduduk pun bercakap tentang kita.

intro.en-MY: My kopitiam closes at three. But this corner needs somewhere for late-night teh tarik and roti canai… My friend Shah has been dreaming of a 24-hour mamak.
intro.ms-MY: Kopitiam saya tutup pukul tiga. Tapi simpang ini perlukan tempat untuk teh tarik dan roti canai lewat malam… Kawan saya Shah dah lama impikan restoran mamak 24 jam.

outro.en-MY: Shah is flipping roti already. The futsal boys found it in five minutes.
outro.ms-MY: Shah dah mula tebar roti. Budak-budak futsal jumpa dalam lima minit.

intro.en-MY: Upgrades need timber and bricks. My friend Arjun designs furniture — he could run a makerspace!
intro.ms-MY: Naik taraf perlukan kayu dan bata. Kawan saya Arjun mereka perabot — dia boleh uruskan ruang kreatif!

outro.en-MY: Arjun is cutting timber already. Upgrades, here we come!
outro.ms-MY: Arjun dah mula memotong kayu. Naik taraf, kami datang!

intro.en-MY: The children have nowhere quiet to study after school. My former student Kavitha could run a tuition centre above the shoplots.
intro.ms-MY: Budak-budak tiada tempat yang tenang untuk belajar selepas sekolah. Bekas murid saya, Kavitha, boleh uruskan pusat tuisyen di atas rumah kedai.

outro.en-MY: Listen to them laughing over the quiz! That’s the sound of learning.
outro.ms-MY: Dengar mereka ketawa semasa kuiz! Itulah bunyi orang belajar.

intro.en-MY: With a florist we could make orchid bouquets for every celebration.
intro.ms-MY: Dengan kedai bunga kita boleh buat jambangan orkid untuk setiap keraian.

outro.en-MY: Flowers for every doorstep — and every condo lift lobby!
outro.ms-MY: Bunga untuk setiap pintu — dan setiap lobi lif kondo!

intro.en-MY: Every good neighbourhood needs a cool place to sit by the water. Shall we build a Fountain Plaza with shade trees and benches — together?
intro.ms-MY: Setiap kejiranan yang baik perlukan tempat yang nyaman untuk duduk tepi air. Jom kita bina Plaza Air Pancut dengan pokok teduhan dan bangku — bersama-sama?

outro.en-MY: Our Fountain Plaza — built by everyone, for everyone.
outro.ms-MY: Plaza Air Pancut kita — dibina oleh semua, untuk semua.

label.en-MY: Contribute to the Fountain Plaza 3 times
label.ms-MY: Sumbang kepada Plaza Air Pancut 3 kali

intro.en-MY: A neighbourhood park with a jogging track would give everyone a place to slow down. And Aisyah has plans…
intro.ms-MY: Taman kejiranan dengan trek joging beri semua orang tempat untuk berehat. Dan Aisyah ada rancangan…

outro.en-MY: Aisyah has already started a jogging-club group chat!
outro.ms-MY: Aisyah dah pun buka kumpulan sembang kelab joging!

intro.en-MY: We’re running out of room! Let’s open up a new lot.
intro.ms-MY: Ruang dah tak cukup! Jom buka lot baharu.

outro.en-MY: So much space! The possibilities…
outro.ms-MY: Luasnya! Banyak yang boleh dibuat…

label.en-MY: Unlock a new plot of land

intro.en-MY: My futsal teammate Farid knows everything about electric cars. He’d love a showroom where people can come, look and ask questions.
intro.ms-MY: Rakan sepasukan futsal saya, Farid, tahu segala-galanya tentang kereta elektrik. Dia mahu bilik pameran tempat orang datang melihat dan bertanya.

outro.en-MY: Farid has polished every car twice and explained charging to three aunties already.
outro.ms-MY: Farid dah gilap setiap kereta dua kali dan terangkan cara mengecas kepada tiga orang mak cik.

intro.en-MY: Hi, I’m Joanna — a photographer thinking of moving to Seri Bayu. I need somewhere bright to edit photos, and half the neighbourhood works from home. A co-working hub, maybe?
intro.ms-MY: Hai, saya Joanna — jurugambar yang bercadang berpindah ke Seri Bayu. Saya perlukan tempat yang terang untuk menyunting gambar, dan separuh kejiranan bekerja dari rumah. Hab kerja bersama, mungkin?

outro.en-MY: Good kopi, fast Wi-Fi and a view of the lake. I think I’m staying!
outro.ms-MY: Kopi sedap, Wi-Fi laju dan pemandangan tasik. Rasanya saya nak tinggal di sini!

intro.en-MY: With all this produce, we need a mini mart that never closes.
intro.ms-MY: Dengan semua hasil ini, kita perlukan kedai serbaneka yang tak pernah tutup.

outro.en-MY: The 24/7 Mini Mart is open — and the lights stay on all night!
outro.ms-MY: Kedai Serbaneka 24 Jam dah dibuka — dan lampunya menyala sepanjang malam!

intro.en-MY: Joanna, the photographer from Sabah, wants to move here for good. She needs good light — a condo with a lake view!
intro.ms-MY: Joanna, jurugambar dari Sabah, mahu berpindah ke sini terus. Dia perlukan cahaya yang baik — kondominium dengan pemandangan tasik!

outro.en-MY: Joanna is already photographing the sunset from her balcony.
outro.ms-MY: Joanna dah mula merakam matahari terbenam dari balkoninya.

intro.en-MY: Every neighbourhood needs a community centre — for community dinners, residents’ meetings and rainy-day badminton. I’ve drawn up plans. Colour-coded.
intro.ms-MY: Setiap kejiranan perlukan pusat komuniti — untuk makan malam bersama, mesyuarat penduduk dan badminton hari hujan. Saya dah lukis pelannya. Berkod warna.

outro.en-MY: A community centre! Now we’re a real neighbourhood.
outro.ms-MY: Pusat komuniti! Sekarang kita kejiranan yang sebenar.

intro.en-MY: I want every neighbour to taste my father’s kopi. Bring me 4 cups to hand out at the LRT exit?
intro.ms-MY: Saya mahu setiap jiran rasa kopi resipi ayah saya. Bawakan 4 cawan untuk diedarkan di pintu keluar LRT?

outro.en-MY: They all came back for more! I’m putting up a chalkboard menu so the commuters know we’re open.
outro.ms-MY: Semua datang semula! Saya akan letak papan menu supaya penumpang tren tahu kita dah buka.

label.ms-MY: Bawa 4 Kopi kepada Pak Cik Lim

worldChange.en-MY: A chalkboard menu appears outside the kopitiam.
worldChange.ms-MY: Papan menu muncul di luar kopitiam.

intro.en-MY: Mei and I want to bring back my father’s weekend breakfast: kaya toast, soft-boiled eggs and kopi. We need 2 sets to test it.
intro.ms-MY: Saya dan Mei mahu hidupkan semula sarapan hujung minggu ayah saya: roti bakar kaya, telur separuh masak dan kopi. Kami perlukan 2 set untuk mencuba.

outro.en-MY: Just like my father’s Sundays. Here — a café umbrella for your own garden.
outro.ms-MY: Sama macam hari Ahad zaman ayah saya. Nah — payung kafe untuk laman awak.

label.en-MY: Bring Uncle Lim 2 Kaya Toast Sets
label.ms-MY: Bawa 2 Set Roti Bakar Kaya kepada Pak Cik Lim

worldChange.en-MY: Breakfast tables now line the covered walkway.
worldChange.ms-MY: Meja sarapan kini tersusun di kaki lima berbumbung.

intro.en-MY: I want to thank everyone who helped bring Father’s kopitiam back. Mango cake and flowers on every table…
intro.ms-MY: Saya mahu berterima kasih kepada semua yang membantu menghidupkan semula kopitiam ayah. Kek mangga dan bunga di setiap meja…

outro.en-MY: You made this new neighbourhood feel like home — for me and for everyone.
outro.ms-MY: Awak jadikan kejiranan baharu ini terasa seperti rumah — untuk saya dan untuk semua.

label.en-MY: Bring Uncle Lim a Mango Cake and a Bouquet
label.ms-MY: Bawa Kek Mangga dan Jambangan kepada Pak Cik Lim

worldChange.en-MY: Lantern posts are now available to light your streets.
worldChange.ms-MY: Tiang lampu taman kini boleh menerangi jalan anda.

intro.en-MY: My mango cake keeps sinking in the middle. Riper mangoes might fix it — bring me 2?
intro.ms-MY: Kek mangga saya asyik mendap di tengah. Mangga yang lebih masak mungkin boleh bantu — bawakan 2?

outro.en-MY: It stands tall! Version twelve is the one. I’m painting it on the sign.
outro.ms-MY: Tak mendap lagi! Versi kedua belas inilah dia. Saya akan lukis di papan tanda.

worldChange.en-MY: The café sign now shows Mei’s mango cake.
worldChange.ms-MY: Papan tanda kafe kini menunjukkan kek mangga Mei.

intro.en-MY: Let’s hold a dessert sale for the school library fund! I need 5 Roti and 3 Kopi for the cart.
intro.ms-MY: Jom buat jualan pencuci mulut untuk tabung perpustakaan sekolah! Saya perlukan 5 Roti dan 3 Kopi untuk troli.

outro.en-MY: Sold out before the evening train! Take the dessert cart — park it wherever you like.
outro.ms-MY: Habis sebelum tren petang! Ambil troli pencuci mulut ini — letak di mana-mana awak suka.

label.ms-MY: Bawa 5 Roti dan 3 Kopi kepada Mei

intro.en-MY: Even between the condos, this soil is wonderful. Will you help me harvest the first orchids?
intro.ms-MY: Walaupun di antara kondominium, tanah di sini sangat subur. Boleh bantu saya tuai orkid pertama?

outro.en-MY: Look at them! The community garden is truly alive.
outro.ms-MY: Tengok! Kebun komuniti ini benar-benar hidup.

intro.en-MY: Imagine flowers along every jalan… Could you plant 3 flower beds?
intro.ms-MY: Bayangkan bunga di sepanjang setiap jalan… Boleh tanam 3 batas bunga?

outro.en-MY: The butterflies found them already! Here, a bird bath — the sunbirds deserve a treat too.
outro.ms-MY: Rama-rama dah jumpa! Nah, kolam burung — burung kelicap pun patut dapat hadiah.

worldChange.en-MY: Butterflies now gather around your flower beds.
worldChange.ms-MY: Rama-rama kini berkumpul di batas bunga anda.

intro.en-MY: Lim works so hard, from the first train to the last. Let’s surprise him — bring me 2 bouquets?
intro.ms-MY: Lim bekerja keras, dari tren pertama hingga tren terakhir. Jom kejutkan dia — bawakan 2 jambangan?

outro.en-MY: He pretended the kopi steam got in his eyes. You’re a good friend.
outro.ms-MY: Dia buat-buat wap kopi masuk mata. Awak kawan yang baik.

label.ms-MY: Bawa 2 Jambangan kepada Mak Cik Zainab

intro.en-MY: Let’s get this makerspace humming. Cut 4 timber with me?
intro.ms-MY: Jom hidupkan ruang kreatif ini. Potong 4 kayu dengan saya?

outro.en-MY: Now that’s a stack to be proud of!
outro.ms-MY: Itu timbunan yang membanggakan!

intro.en-MY: Opening day! I need a bouquet for the stage and 3 kopi for the volunteers. And the jogging club. And the morning aerobics aunties.
intro.ms-MY: Hari perasmian! Saya perlukan jambangan untuk pentas dan 3 kopi untuk sukarelawan. Dan kelab joging. Dan mak cik aerobik pagi.

outro.en-MY: Best. Opening. Ever. The park is officially open!
outro.ms-MY: Perasmian. Paling. Hebat. Taman dah dibuka secara rasmi!

label.en-MY: Bring Aisyah a Bouquet and 3 Kopi
label.ms-MY: Bawa Jambangan dan 3 Kopi kepada Aisyah

worldChange.en-MY: Bunting is strung across the park.

intro.en-MY: Will you be my first student at the centre? Answer 3 quiz questions — right or wrong, it all counts.
intro.ms-MY: Sudikah awak jadi murid pertama di pusat ini? Jawab 3 soalan kuiz — betul atau salah, semuanya dikira.

outro.en-MY: Wonderful! You asked better questions than you answered — that’s the best kind of student.
outro.ms-MY: Hebat! Soalan awak lebih bagus daripada jawapan — itulah murid yang terbaik.

intro.en-MY: Help me arrange the display? Try a few colours — let’s make the EVs look like a garden.
intro.ms-MY: Bantu saya susun pameran? Cuba beberapa warna — jom buat kereta EV nampak macam taman.

outro.en-MY: Look — people are stopping just to smile at it. And to ask about charging, of course.
outro.ms-MY: Tengok — orang berhenti semata-mata untuk tersenyum. Dan bertanya tentang pengecasan, sudah tentu.

title.ms-MY: Selamat Hari Jadi, Pak Cik Lim

intro.en-MY: Uncle Lim’s birthday is on Saturday and he keeps pretending he forgot. Shh — help me throw a surprise party at the kopitiam? I need 2 Mango Cakes and a Bouquet.
intro.ms-MY: Hari jadi Pak Cik Lim hari Sabtu dan dia buat-buat lupa. Shh — tolong saya buat parti kejutan di kopitiam? Saya perlukan 2 Kek Mangga dan sejambak Jambangan.

outro.en-MY: His face! He laughed so hard he nearly dropped his cup. Then he made everyone kopi “because it’s my party”.
outro.ms-MY: Muka dia! Dia ketawa sampai hampir terjatuh cawan. Lepas itu dia bancuh kopi untuk semua “sebab ini parti saya”.

label.en-MY: Bring Mei 2 Mango Cakes and a Bouquet
label.ms-MY: Bawa 2 Kek Mangga dan Jambangan kepada Mei

intro.en-MY: New idea: mango cake with a kaya swirl. Uncle Lim says “no need to change perfection”. I say… taste test! 2 Kaya and 2 Mangoes, please.
intro.ms-MY: Idea baharu: kek mangga dengan pusaran kaya. Pak Cik Lim kata “tak perlu ubah yang sempurna”. Saya kata… uji rasa! 2 Kaya dan 2 Mangga, ya.

outro.en-MY: Verdict: Uncle Lim had four slices “for science”. Version thirteen is now a secret menu item.
outro.ms-MY: Keputusan: Pak Cik Lim makan empat potong “untuk sains”. Versi tiga belas kini menu rahsia.

label.ms-MY: Bawa 2 Kaya dan 2 Mangga kepada Mei

intro.en-MY: Mei’s shiba, Biscuit, has escaped into the condo garden again! She only comes out for roti. Could you bring 2 Roti — quickly, before she reaches the orchids?
intro.ms-MY: Biskut, anjing shiba Mei, terlepas ke taman kondo lagi! Dia cuma keluar kalau ada roti. Boleh bawa 2 Roti — cepat, sebelum dia sampai ke orkid?

outro.en-MY: Found her asleep under the ixora with a petal on her nose. Unforgivable. And completely adorable.
outro.ms-MY: Jumpa dia tidur di bawah pokok jejarum dengan kelopak di hidungnya. Tak boleh dimaafkan. Dan sangat comel.

label.ms-MY: Bawa 2 Roti kepada Mak Cik Zainab

intro.en-MY: I know the light here better than the people! Would you introduce me around? Say hello to a few neighbours with me.
intro.ms-MY: Saya lebih kenal cahaya di sini daripada orangnya! Boleh kenalkan saya? Jom tegur beberapa jiran bersama saya.

outro.en-MY: Everyone said hi! Mak Cik Zainab gave me cuttings for my balcony and Aisyah already added me to three group chats.
outro.ms-MY: Semua orang tegur! Mak Cik Zainab beri keratan pokok untuk balkoni saya dan Aisyah dah masukkan saya dalam tiga kumpulan sembang.

intro.en-MY: My futsal kids keep asking for a playground. If we all chip in at the bare lot, I’ll build the slide myself. Help it along twice?
intro.ms-MY: Budak-budak futsal saya asyik minta taman permainan. Kalau kita semua menyumbang di tanah lapang itu, saya bina gelongsor sendiri. Bantu dua kali?

outro.en-MY: They tested the slide forty-seven times. Officially approved.
outro.ms-MY: Mereka uji gelongsor itu empat puluh tujuh kali. Lulus secara rasmi.

label.ms-MY: Bantu di taman permainan dua kali

intro.en-MY: The pocket park needs an opening picnic and I have a list. A long list. In a spreadsheet. First item: you! Help finish the Pocket Park?
intro.ms-MY: Taman poket perlukan kelah pembukaan dan saya ada senarai. Senarai panjang. Dalam hamparan. Perkara pertama: awak! Bantu siapkan Taman Poket?

outro.en-MY: Mats, kuih, kites and the whole neighbourhood on the grass. I didn’t even need the clipboard. (I used it anyway.)
outro.ms-MY: Tikar, kuih, wau dan seluruh kejiranan di atas rumput. Saya tak perlukan papan klip pun. (Tapi saya guna juga.)

description.en-MY: Aisyah and Mak Cik Zainab are filling the streets and condo lobbies with orchids! Join in at your own pace — every goal you reach adds festival rewards.
description.ms-MY: Aisyah dan Mak Cik Zainab memenuhi jalan dan lobi kondo dengan orkid! Sertai mengikut rentak sendiri — setiap matlamat menambah ganjaran pesta.

description.en-MY: The shoplot walkway turns into one long table and everyone brings something to share — kopi, roti and Shah’s roti canai. Cook, serve and taste your way through the night.
description.ms-MY: Kaki lima rumah kedai menjadi satu meja panjang dan semua orang membawa sesuatu untuk dikongsi — kopi, roti dan roti canai Shah. Masak, hidang dan rasa sepanjang malam.

description.en-MY: Arjun brought his guitar, Joanna a cajón and Shah a very loud tambourine… Light up the streets, chat with neighbours and enjoy the music.
description.ms-MY: Arjun bawa gitar, Joanna bawa cajón dan Shah bawa tamborin yang sangat kuat… Terangi jalan, berbual dengan jiran dan nikmati muzik.

name.en-MY: Garden Party at the Pocket Park

description.en-MY: The new pocket park between the condos is ready for its first party: orchids on every table, little gifts and a lot of laughter.
description.ms-MY: Taman poket baharu di antara kondominium sedia untuk parti pertamanya: orkid di setiap meja, hadiah kecil dan banyak gelak tawa.

description.en-MY: Stalls light up the new plaza by the LRT: kaya, roti, grocery boxes and neighbours swapping stories. Bring your best goods!
description.ms-MY: Gerai-gerai menerangi dataran baharu berhampiran LRT: kaya, roti, kotak barang dapur dan jiran bertukar cerita. Bawa barangan terbaik anda!

description.en-MY: Bows, bandanas and a very proud parade around the playground, led by Biscuit. Treat the pets and cheer them on!
description.ms-MY: Reben, selendang dan perarakan yang sangat bangga di sekitar taman permainan, diketuai Biskut. Beri haiwan peliharaan habuan dan sorak untuk mereka!

description.en-MY: A big screen goes up on the Skyline Deck for an outdoor film. Kopi, mango cake, cushions everywhere and a funny old movie with the city lights behind it.
description.ms-MY: Skrin besar dipasang di Dek Langit untuk tayangan filem terbuka. Kopi, kek mangga, kusyen di mana-mana dan filem lama yang lucu berlatarkan lampu bandar.

description.en-MY: Another year of Seri Bayu! Everyone pitches in to make the neighbourhood look its very best for the big day.
description.ms-MY: Setahun lagi untuk Seri Bayu! Semua orang bergotong-royong supaya kejiranan kelihatan paling cantik untuk hari besar.

description.en-MY: Help the neighbourhood build a Fountain Plaza with shade trees and seating, so everyone has a cool place to sit and meet. Every contribution brings it a step closer.
description.ms-MY: Bantu kejiranan membina Plaza Air Pancut dengan pokok teduhan dan tempat duduk, supaya semua orang ada tempat yang redup untuk duduk dan bertemu. Setiap sumbangan membawanya selangkah lebih dekat.

description.en-MY: Complete a community landmark.
description.ms-MY: Siapkan mercu tanda komuniti.

history.en-MY: You moved into your terrace house in Seri Bayu.
history.ms-MY: Anda berpindah ke rumah teres anda di Seri Bayu.
